name: password-input
title: Password Input
summary: A password field with a button that shows or hides what was typed.
description: A password field with a button that shows or hides what was typed. A password field with a show / hide Button at its end: an InputGroup (the Input's look and sizes) whose end addon is a ghost, xs, square, muted Button with a tooltip, as Search's clear button. Ark UI's password-input switches the Input's type, names the Button (Show password / Hide password) and keeps the caret in the field when the Button is pressed with the pointer. Inside a Field it is wired to the label, helper and error.

anatomy.description: Ark's password-input root around the InputGroup; class and style land here.
The Input inside the InputGroup (data-password-input="input"): type password, or text while shown; spellcheck and autocapitalize off; autocomplete current-password or new-password.

The Button (data-password-input="visibility-trigger"): ghost, xs, square, muted; an eye while hidden, an eye with a slash while shown. aria-label and tooltip say what a press does; aria-controls the input.

value.description: The Input's value. Controlled: value with onChange. Uncontrolled: defaultValue.

visible.description: The password shown as text. Controlled with onVisibleChange; uncontrolled: defaultVisible.

size.description: The Input's sizes (`lib/control.ts`): xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px.

variant.description: The shared control's looks (`lib/control.ts`), at every size. outline: the form field (field colour, hairline). subtle: the inspector (inset grey, no edge). ghost: nothing until touched. Focused, open and invalid look the same in every variant.

ignorePasswordManagers.description: Ask password managers not to fill or offer this field.

showLabel.description: The Button's name while the password is hidden.

hideLabel.description: The Button's name while the password is shown.

start.description: Addon before the field (a lock icon).

events.visibleChange: (visible: boolean) after a press on the Button

keyboard: Tab: the field, then the Button
Space / Enter on the Button: show or hide; focus stays on the Button
notes: The Button's aria-label says what a press does (Show password / Hide password) and changes with it; aria-controls points at the input.
A pointer press on the Button keeps the caret in the field.
Needs a name: a Field label or an aria-label.

motion: the InputGroup's ring and fill; the Button's press scale and hover fill (pointer only)
the icon swaps at once, from the pointer and the keyboard alike
